description: This file contains automated test cases for verifying the GET and SET handlers of device IP, device info, device services, and reverse SSH configurations in a TR-069 based managed device platform. It uses pytest for structuring tests and custom helper functions to interact with rbus data model.

methods.name: test_DeviceDefault_Set_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Tests getting multiple device info parameters and a specific feature enable flag, verifying responses contain expected values.

methods.name: test_DeviceIP_Set_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Tests retrieving various IPv6 and IPv4 interface parameters, asserting expected values are returned.

methods.name: test_DeviceServices_Set_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Verifies the number of entries in device services.

methods.name: test_ReverseSSH_Set_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Tests retrieving SSH reverse tunnel status, setting trigger and arguments, verifying success responses.
